WITH RECURSIVE product_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM ip_investment_pool WHERE pool_code = 'bond_product_root' AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM ip_investment_pool child INNER JOIN product_tree pt ON child.parent_id = pt.id WHERE child.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT p.id ,p.pool_name ,p.pool_type ,p.market_codes ,p.variety_codes ,p.description ,p.max_capacity ,p.batch_in_flow_id ,p.batch_in_flow_key ,p.batch_in_flow_name ,p.batch_out_flow_id ,p.batch_out_flow_key ,p.batch_out_flow_name FROM ip_investment_pool p INNER JOIN product_tree pt ON pt.id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0
AND p.id IN
#{poolId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY p.outer_sort ASC ,p.inner_sort ASC ,p.id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE product_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM ip_investment_pool WHERE pool_code = 'bond_product_root' AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM ip_investment_pool child INNER JOIN product_tree pt ON child.parent_id = pt.id WHERE child.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ip_investment_pool p INNER JOIN product_tree pt ON pt.id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 )
